subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should the session/transcript SQLite flip and removal of file-shaped Plugin SDK surfaces ship together as one one-way compatibility boundary?
rationale: That choice deliberately changes persisted state, downgrade behavior, CLI migration workflow, and external plugin contracts; code inspection cannot establish the repository's intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve combined one-way flip
options.body: Ship the migration and SDK removal together after the branch is cleaned and exact-head upgrade, continuity, and recovery proof is accepted.

options.title: Retain a deprecation window
options.body: Move canonical runtime storage to SQLite while temporarily preserving explicitly named shipped Plugin SDK compatibility surfaces.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the accessor-backed file runtime until the migration and compatibility removals can be staged in smaller independently reviewable boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve combined one-way flip
recommendation.body: Ship the migration and SDK removal together after the branch is cleaned and exact-head upgrade, continuity, and recovery proof is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest long-term history across the central storage and Plugin SDK paths affected by this permanent compatibility decision.
